parole.testo: From Old Swedish famn (fampn, fambn, fagm, fagn, faghn, faam), from Old East Norse *famna-, *faþmna- (compare Danish favn), derivatives of Old Norse faðmr, from Proto-Germanic *faþmaz, from Proto-Indo-European *pat-, *pet-.
